description: Generate a 360° equirectangular HDRI panorama of a place (costs credits — exact price via get_cost: true). Pass loc_id to persist it on that board, so the viewer finds it again; without loc_id it is a one-off.

camera_height.description: Camera height in metres (default 1.6, roughly eye level)

get_cost.description: Free: the exact price of this operation; nothing is rendered or charged. Name it to the person before the real run.

intent.description: What the place is — the panorama prompt

loc_id.description: Persist the panorama on this location board (from lab_list_locations)

name: lab_location_panorama
title: Location Panorama
